## Known handling

- **Timestamp units.** Verified by probe on 2026-08-24: USD-M futures klines are
  milliseconds throughout 2024–2026, but **spot klines switched to microseconds**
  (16 digits) by 2026-06 while 2024-06 was still milliseconds. `canonical._to_millis`
  normalises by magnitude, never by filename or date. Concatenating the two eras
  unnormalised puts half the history in 1970 — silently, since every value stays a
  plausible integer.
- **Header rows.** USD-M futures klines are headed; spot klines are headerless even in
  2026. Both are handled by sniffing the first line.
- **aggTrades caveat.** Column 0 of an aggTrades CSV is the aggregate trade *id*, not a
  timestamp. Do not reuse the kline reader for it.
- **Deduplication.** Overlapping month boundaries are deduped on `ts_ms`, keeping first.
